paper.title: Worms: Identifying Impacts on Education and Health in the Presence of Treatment Externalities

paper_reference.paper_question: 学校层面整群随机分批发放驱虫药，项目整体效应与跨校溢出各有多大？
paper_reference.target: 九所学校在两种覆盖方案各 1/2 的随机政策下的平均出勤率；九校等权。
paper_reference.source_location: Miguel and Kremer (2004) Econometrica 72(1):159-217, DOI 10.1111/j.1468-0262.2004.00481.x. Abstract and Introduction (pp. 159-161) for the externality motivation; Section 3 (p. 165) for the three-group phased roll-out; Section 4.1 (p. 175) for cluster randomization and cross-school spillovers. Project-built scenario; the paper does not pose this question.
conditions: Two complete coverage lists with known probabilities 1/2 each.
Coverage choice independent of the nine schools' potential attendance.
Observed attendance corresponds to the executed coverage.
Neighbourhood within a zone fixed before treatment.
Spillover enters only through the number of treated schools in the zone; no common annual shock.
what_paper_supports: School-level cluster randomization as business context, identifying the programme effect under within-school spillovers (Section 4.1).
Cross-school spillovers identified from the local density of treated schools (Section 4.1).
Wider coverage must count the extra benefit to already-covered schools from neighbouring coverage (Abstract; Introduction).
what_paper_does_not_support: The 6 and 3 percentage points are synthetic parameters, not paper estimates.
No decomposition of the treated-school effect into direct and within-school spillover.
No extrapolation from attendance to test scores.
No claim that nine synthetic schools represent Busia or the 75 schools.
No claim that the 0.04 phase difference is the paper's policy effect: the paper randomized once, and the phases differ in years.
No claim that groups 1 and 2 have identical direct effects: exposure lasts two years in group 1 and one year in group 2.

missing_condition.reason: The probabilities of the two coverage plans are omitted; the fact layer stops with EXTENDED_NETWORK_FACTS_INCOMPLETE.

changed_target.reason: Evaluation population moves to the three schools of group C (3, 6, 9); target and weights must be rebound.

actual_run.provenance: 2026-11-15 local structured run through the extended network finite-policy entry with explicit synthetic reviews; api_calls=0.
actual_run.note: 三个变体均在本地结构化运行；不调用 LLM；不读取公开材料以外的参考内容。

notes: Scenario adaptation; the paper does not pose this question. The two plans map to the treatment status of groups 1 and 3 of the paper. Coverage sizes differ (six versus nine schools), so the target is a randomized-policy mixture rather than an endpoint contrast.
